evidence.claim: Attribution reproduced from the per-edge parquet. ef was approximated as relink_new* & edge_prob<0.3 & (ilp_src_other|ilp_dst_other) & src_outdeg<2, with the re-link label from alt_fwd/alt_bwd and est = 0.95*(0.9*dFP - dTP + addTP - 0.9*addFP)/128,883. With an absolute 3.5 um flag on the median PRE-linefit step of the relink_ilp_tight edges: big-step transitions hold 11.1% of edges and 1,982 FP, and ef drops 1,229 FP / 88 TP there (est +0.0091). Post-freeze transitions: 483 FP / 33 TP dropped (+0.0039). Normal transitions hold 82% of edges: 177 FP / 113 TP dropped (+0.0006). This matches the hypothesis (1,235 / 487 / 181 FP).

Finer binning (frozen and post-freeze excluded) shows that ef's drop precision rises with the transition step. Median ILP step <=1.7 um (9,011 transitions, 1.89M edges): drop precision 0.49, est -0.00005 (neutral). 1.7-2.4 um: +0.0002. 2.4-3.3 um: +0.0002 per bin (precision ~0.78). 3.6-4.5 um: precision 0.91, +0.0030. >4.5 um: precision 0.95, +0.0061, with a base edge FP rate of 0.238 (vs 0.04 on ordinary transitions). On ordinary transitions ef neither helps nor hurts: it gates itself.

The absolute 3.5 um flag marks a regime of fast transitions, not rare anomalies. It fires on 22.8% of 6bba transitions (median 17%, max 80%), and 87/199 videos exceed 15%, which fails the hypothesis's own <=15% criterion. P(big)=0.148 and P(big | previous transition big)=0.47, so big steps come in runs.

The proposed RELATIVE flag (1.8x the video's median step) keeps much less of ef than the claimed 90%. With the pre-linefit ILP-tight median, the 'normal' class still carries est +0.0060 of ~0.0136 (44%); at 2.2x it carries +0.0072 (53%). At 1.5x it carries +0.0032 (23%), but the flag then fires on 14.5% of 6bba transitions (68 videos >15%). Drop precision on the 2.2x 'normal' transitions is still 86% (1,049 FP vs 170 TP), so ef is not risky on these transitions.

A video's median step is quantized by the integer voxel coordinates (1.625 um = one z voxel, then 2.298, 2.81 ...). The median of video medians is 1.625 on 44b6 and 2.30 on 6bba, so a threshold relative to this median jumps by 40% between neighbouring videos. Linefit shrinks steps: abs 3.5 on post-linefit coordinates flags 3.4% of edges vs 11.1% pre-linefit. The kernel's ef runs AFTER linefit, so any flag must be computed on pre-linefit coordinates captured before linefit.
evidence.source: efattr.out; tools/build_probe_kernel.py EDGEFILTER_FN (runs after linefit) and EDGEFILTER_CAPTURE

evidence.claim: Frozen (duplicated) frames are a real data artifact. In the train cache they occur only in 6bba (7.2% of transitions, 114/128 videos) and never in 44b6. The forum reports identical consecutive volumes where the GT still moves up to 8.9 um, and shares a per-video list of frozen frames.

evidence.claim: Zebrafish light-sheet pipelines routinely correct drift and register frames in time before tracking, and large inter-frame displacements (low frame rates) are a known source of linking ambiguity. This supports 'big steps -> relink errors' in general. There is no competition-specific evidence on how often drift occurs in the hidden embryos.

The 4 visible test clips are copies of train videos, so the kernel cannot measure the hidden embryos' anomaly rate. Logging flag counts there only checks that the code path matches the replay; it says nothing about the public or private embryos.

gshift's -0.002 on the LB (probe 23, on exp29) does not show that the public embryo has few drift jumps. gshift changed the relink cost globally, and three different relink changes all landed at 0.945. At most this is weak evidence.

implementation_notes: The mechanism (ef's gain sits in anomalous transitions) is CONFIRMED and sharpened: ef's gain grows steadily with the transition's median ILP step and is ~0 (-0.00005) on ordinary <=1.7 um transitions. So ef_anom ~= ef. With an absolute 3.5 um pre-linefit flag plus post-freeze, it differs from ef by est 0.0003 (confirmation) to 0.0006 (all 199 videos), which no probe can resolve (LB granularity 0.001). With the proposed relative 1.8x flag it throws away 25-55% of ef's local gain on transitions where drop precision is 80-86%, so that variant hurts rather than protects. PITFALLS: (1) The flag must use PRE-linefit coordinates (linefit cuts the flag rate ~3x). ef runs after linefit in the kernel, so the pre-linefit per-t median must be captured in EDGEFILTER_CAPTURE from the ILP edges and the node coordinates before linefit. (2) Integer-voxel coordinates quantize the median step (1.625 / 2.298 / 2.81 um), which makes a relative threshold unstable. Once the x138 coordinate head lands (float coordinates), every threshold shifts. If a flag is ever needed, use the mean of the ILP steps or a continuous drift estimate (|median displacement vector|). (3) Frozen-frame detection needs no labels and is exact: a transition is frozen when >80% of its edges have len_pre==0 (exact duplicate detections). Post-freeze = the transition after a frozen one. (4) The flag fires on up to 80% of transitions in some 6bba videos, so a 'fraction of transitions' success criterion is meaningless for ef. (5) The parquet approximation of ef is ef_a3-like (ILP evidence on either side), not exactly ef_a3_rl_pr: the cache used tight gate 6.0 and the kernel uses 5.5, and 9.5% of drops differ.
refined_change: Do NOT build or probe ef_anom as a separate variant. ef already gates itself: locally it is neutral on ordinary transitions (est -0.00005 on <=1.7 um steps). Every restriction either equals ef (absolute flag, delta < 0.0006, below LB resolution) or discards 25-55% of the gain on transitions where drops are still >80% precise (relative flag). Keep the FINALS POLICY, restated with the new numbers. Let S29 = exp49 public - exp39 public (0.947) and S30 = exp50 - 0.947. (a) S29 >= +0.003: the public embryo has anomalous transitions. ef_a3_rl_pr becomes the base for both finals, with stitch etc. bundled on top. (b) -0.002 <= S29 < +0.003 (flat): keep ef in ONE final anyway (e.g. exp48 + ef, i.e. leaf prune + DaughterNet + ef), and leave ef out of the other. Reason: the only harm ef can do on ordinary transitions is bounded locally at ~0.0005 in either direction, while the private embryos (71% of the score) may have freezes or drift as 6bba does (7.2% frozen transitions; 15% of transitions with median step >3.5 um). (c) S29 <= -0.003: this is larger than anything the ordinary-transition drops can explain locally, so the harm comes from elsewhere (in-sample re-links to ILP alternatives, gate 5.5 vs 6.0, or prune). Drop ef_a3_rl_pr. If S30 >= -0.001, the drop-only variant may take its place in the final under policy (b). No ef_anom probe: spend the slots on coordhead/stitch.
refined_lab_test: No new probe. Run one cheap replay readout to validate the parquet approximation (Kaggle CPU lab or the main session's idle-priority replay). Run replay.py --split confirmation twice: (i) ef_a3_rl_pr; (ii) the same plus a new knob ef.anom_min_step_um=3.5, post-freeze always on. The per-t flag is the median PRE-linefit length of the ILP edges (captured before linefit), and ef candidates are kept only on flagged t. Report each video's delta vs exp39 split by class (frozen / post-freeze / big-step / ordinary, defined as in efbin.py), plus delta(ef) - delta(ef_anom) with a bootstrap CI over videos. Expected: ef_anom within 0.0006 of ef (the CI of the difference covers 0 or is slightly positive) and the ordinary-transition class within +-0.0005. If the ordinary class is <= -0.001 on confirmation, reconsider ef_anom: it would then be a real hedge. Cost: 2 replay runs on 135 videos, about the same as the original ef confirmation. Kernel side: the finals policy needs no change. If ef_anom were ever shipped, add a pre-linefit capture of the per-t ILP median step and log per-clip flagged-transition counts on the 4 dummy clips (train copies, so they only verify the code path).
expected_gain: Direct LB gain of the ef_anom variant: ~0. It matches ef within 0.0006 locally, or loses 0.004-0.008 with the relative flag. The value is in the decision rule: it keeps a flat public probe from discarding a rule worth +0.016 locally. Guessed private gain from keeping ef in one final after a flat public result: +0.002..+0.008, depending on how often the hidden embryos have frozen frames or fast/drift transitions (6bba-like: most of the +0.016; 44b6-like: ~+0.0015 from the anomalous part alone). Public: read directly from probe 29.
